title: Coach Arena gold fixture
description: One coaching turn to grade. The memoryState renders into the CONTEXT block the coach is given; the bad/excellent examples anchor the judge; disqualifiers feed the deterministic checker.

category.description: grouping for the report (e.g. deep-assessment, trust-repair, interview-prep)

voice.description: the user's chosen voice; selects the coach personality

goal.description: the user's aim / why they're here

userTurn.description: the message being answered this turn

evidence.description: raw signals (informational; also shown to the judge)

memoryState.description: structured durable state -> rendered to the CONTEXT block (see lib/context.mjs for keys)

emotionalSignal.description: human temperature of the turn (a hypothesis)

expectedCoachMove.description: what a strong coach should do this turn

disqualifiers.description: things that should tank the reply; string (substring) or object {pattern, regex, cap, penalty}
